# README artwork

`banner-ru-ai-v2.png` and `flow-ru-ai-v2.png` were generated with OpenAI's image
 generator for Kinkan's Russian README, using the previous banner/diagram as
content references. Both images preserve the original Russian wording and the
TrustTunnel fallback direction. Original SVGs remain available; the English
README uses them.

`scripts/readme/make-assets.py` rebuilds the original SVGs and demo screenshot
video; it does not recreate or overwrite the AI-generated PNGs.
`scripts/readme/sync.py` synchronizes the README entrypoints.
